text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho and first G1 race
of the
senior year has arrived and will
serve as the stage
for Ryan's fierce
battle with McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
McQueen is aiming to fulfill her
long-held dream,
while Мэдзиро Райан is
looking to stop her and
prove her own
true worth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Neither competitor is willing to concede
their
goals in the race that begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
